| **$x$** | $0$ | $2$ | $10$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **$f(x)$** | $0$ | $0$ | $80$ |

The graph of a parabola $y=f(x)$ passes through the points given by their $(x,y)$-coordinates in the table above. What is the $x$-coordinate of the parabola's vertex?

The $x$-coordinate of the vertex is
{{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
Notice that the roots of the parabola are given. They are 

$$
x=0\,\text{and}\,x=2.
$$

If the coordinates of the vertex are $(h,k),$ then by the average of the roots formula, $h$ is simply the average of the two roots. Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}h & =\frac{0+2}{2} \\  & =1.\end{aligned}
$$
